text: Could you make a seamless loop for my website background showing a calm mountain lake at dusk, with gentle ripples on the water? I’ve been thinking about the site a lot, and I’m hoping this will help it feel a little more welcoming. It should be 6 seconds long and wide 16:9, with the camera staying still throughout. I tend to overthink how background visuals will look once everything else is on the page. Please don’t include any text or sound, and keep the whole thing subtle so I can put my own heading over it.
